# Nazam LLC

> Practical AI automation systems for small businesses, Amazon sellers, and Walmart sellers.

Nazam LLC builds AI automation systems, reporting dashboards, workflow automations, and marketplace growth systems. The company helps small businesses respond faster to leads, reduce manual admin work, simplify booking and CRM workflows, and make operating data easier to see. It also helps Amazon and Walmart sellers review listings, improve reporting, monitor inventory and order issues, and prioritize marketplace growth actions.

Primary URL: https://nazamllc.com/
Contact: admin@nazamllc.com
Founder: Muhammad Nazam
Founder profile: https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammad-nazam/
Area served: United States

## Services

- AI automation for small businesses
- AI chatbot and AI receptionist systems
- Lead capture and follow-up automation
- CRM, email, and appointment booking workflows
- Reporting dashboards and internal automations
- Amazon and Walmart listing review workflows
- Marketplace seller reporting dashboards
- Inventory and order alert workflows
- SEO and PageSpeed monitoring agents
- Weekly performance reporting automations

## Best Starting Point

The free audit reviews one website, workflow, or marketplace store and identifies practical opportunities to save time, improve follow-up, simplify reporting, or strengthen marketplace operations.
